recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast group portrait set against a textured brick wall, illuminated by a single, harsh circular spotlight that leaves the surrounding frame in total blackness. The subjects are posed in dynamic, theatrical stances suggesting a moment of capture or escape.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm brick texture vs. cool black negative space
Dynamic human silhouettes vs. static architectural background
Thin script text vs. heavy visual weight of the central group
coreInvariants: Circular spotlight falloff with soft edges
Warm, golden-yellow lighting on the brick
Subjects dressed in dark, monochromatic clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A cluster of figures occupies the center-middle ground, scaled to fit within the circular light beam.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central spotlight creates a high-contrast focal point against the black void.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-center script, drops to the central spotlight, and follows the outward-pointing gestures of the figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space framing the central action, creating a claustrophobic or secretive atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for the environment and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and terracotta for the brick wall and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the thin script typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the illuminated center and the pitch-black edges; low saturation except for the warm yellow light.

letterConstructionRules: Large, expressive flourishes on capital letters

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in negative space above the spotlight

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script face contrasted against complex photographic textures.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the informal, hand-drawn quality of the original lettering.
Matches the thin, fluid motion of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of people in dark 1970s attire huddled against a weathered brick wall, illuminated by a single circular spotlight in a pitch-black room. The lighting should be warm and high-contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin, white, hand-written cursive title at the top center, ensuring it sits entirely within the black negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the spotlight edge soft but distinct?
Is the text legible against the black background?
Are the figures dressed in dark colors to blend with the shadows?
Is the brick texture visible only within the light circle?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check for total blackness in the corners
Ensure the script is monolinear and thin
Verify the warm color temperature of the lit area
Confirm the theatrical, posed nature of the group
recipe.reuseFormula: Central circular spotlight + textured background + dark-clothed group + top-aligned thin script = Dramatic Capture Aesthetic
